generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: An open-ended negative class is implemented and tested only through a finite enumeration of known bad variants, so unseen variants outside the enumeration can pass while all named examples remain green.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Use a finite set or regex alternatives for known rejected variants and write negative tests only from that same set.
trigger_signals: broad reject class with valid exceptions
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: For open-ended negative classes, require a structural, semantic, provenance, or capability predicate plus at least one negative discriminant absent from implementation enumerations and a positive exception.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Inspect candidate enums/sets/regex tables and attack with a novel discriminant absent from those lists, at least two sibling cases, and a positive valid exception.
